settings.title: Settings
settings.careTeamFooter: Tap-to-call uses the first available number from this list.

early_data.name: Early data

regular_5_1_1.name: Regular 5-1-1

getting_closer.name: Getting closer
getting_closer.description: Intervals tighten over the session without meeting the call rule yet.

spacing_out.name: Spacing out
spacing_out.description: Intervals spread farther apart so the rhythm reads as spacing out.

rhythm.noRhythmBody: Rhythm appears after contractions are recorded.

rhythm.insightIrregularBody: Intervals are still changing from one contraction to the next.
rhythm.insightIrregularAction: Keep timing until a clearer pattern appears.
rhythm.insightNextContractionBody: Time the next contraction to start reading the rhythm.
rhythm.insightKeepTimingBody: Keep timing until the rhythm is clearer.

metadata.subtitle: Free, private contraction log

metadata.screenshotTimer: Time contractions with one large control.
metadata.screenshotShare: Share local summaries with your care team.
